commit_message: Gate ADR0155 product default on measured platform characterization
pr_title: GameEngine: ADR0155 managed Local AI implementation v4
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR0155 managed llama.cpp integration on latest main, including provider-independent backend/runtime lifecycle, AI Studio setup, Windows/WSL identities, GGUF registration, resource arbitration, benchmark provenance, Visual fixture, migration preservation, Windows SHA-256 verification, and deterministic Windows/WSL failure-boundary tests.

Representative WindowsNative versus Wsl2Linux performance characterization is still required to select the normal Managed Local product environment. Until that evidence exists, the existing external-local compatibility path remains the ordinary default and Managed Local AI is an explicit engineering/advanced path.
